candidates.failure_scenario: A dependency ships a dotless LICENCE that vm/qfile lists and refuses. The README tells the operator its importers sit pending as unavailable, but fetch now skips the file (readByVerify) and the importer is approved, which TestUnservedLicenceDoesNotHoldUpImporters asserts (statusApproved). An operator reading the doc expects the opposite outcome from the one the oracle gives.
candidates.verify_by: sed -n 188,191p contribs/gpao/README.md, then read parkeddep_test.go TestUnservedLicenceDoesNotHoldUpImporters (assert.Equal statusApproved) and getter.go readByVerify skipping LICENCE
candidates.evidence: README.md:190 reads 'and one whose files `vm/qfile` cannot serve leaves the package pending as'; parkeddep_test.go now asserts statusApproved for the unservable-LICENCE dependency

candidates.summary: No test fetches a dependency whose module file is the legacy gno.mod, so dropping it from readByVerify stays green
candidates.failure_scenario: A live dependency carries gno.mod and no gnomod.toml (gno.mod is an allowed stored name, mempackage.go:284). If gno.mod left readByVerify's keep list, fetch would hand the typecheck that dependency without a module file; under TCLatestStrict ParseCheckGnoMod returns nil and typeCheckMemPackage panics 'gnomod.toml not found', so the importer is rejected as a verdict. TestRPCGetterNamesReconstructedPackage pins gnomod.toml through its queried list, and nothing pins gno.mod.
candidates.verify_by: delete "gno.mod" from the case in readByVerify and run go test ./contribs/gpao -run 'TestRPCGetter|TestVerifier|TestPackageName': expect red, observe green; grep -l 'gno.mod' contribs/gpao/*_test.go returns nothing
